source.author: stat
source.text: horruit infelix visu longoque profundum incendit clamore nemus; nec territus ille, sed iacet; Argolicas ululatus flebilis aures impulit; extemplo monitu ducis advolat ardens Arcas eques causamque refert, tunc squamea demum torvus ad armorum radios fremitumque virorum colla movet: rapit ingenti conamine saxum, quo discretus ager, vacuasque impellit in auras arduus Hippomedon, quo turbine bellica quondam librati saliunt portarum in claustra molares.
source.text_original: horruit infelix visu longoque profundum / incendit clamore nemus; nec territus ille, / sed iacet; Argolicas ululatus flebilis aures / impulit; extemplo monitu ducis advolat ardens / Arcas eques causamque refert, tunc squamea demum / torvus ad armorum radios fremitumque virorum / colla movet: rapit ingenti conamine saxum, / quo discretus ager, vacuasque impellit in auras / arduus Hippomedon, quo turbine bellica quondam / librati saliunt portarum in claustra molares.
source.text_english: The unhappy man bristled at the sight and with a long shout set the depths of the grove ablaze; and the other, though not frightened, lies there. A mournful howling struck the Argive ears; at once, at the leader’s warning, the fiery Arcadian horseman rushes up and reports the cause, and then at last the grim, scaly one turns his neck toward the gleam of weapons and the roar of men. Hippomedon, towering, snatches up with mighty effort a rock by which the field is divided and hurls it into the empty air; with that whirlwind, once in war, the millstones balanced are flung up and leap against the bolts of the gate.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: At ducis imperiis Minyae monituque frequentes puppem umeris subeunt et tento poplite proni decurrunt intrantque fretum.
reuse.text_original: At ducis imperiis Minyae monituque frequentes / puppem umeris subeunt et tento poplite proni / decurrunt intrantque fretum.
reuse.text_english: But at the commander’s orders and under his urging, the many Minyae take up the ship on their shoulders and, with bent knees, run downhill and enter the strait.
